newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle mixed in slow, technical trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle mixed in slow, technical trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures consolidated recent losses and closed tightly mixed in thin and rangebound trade, floor sources said.
Activity is expected to remain light on Wednesday ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's June supply and demand estimates for the Florida crop.
The USDA will release its report on Thursday at 0830 EDT.
Market soruces do not expect any changes from the May report, however, which pegged the 1996/97 Florida crop at a record 224.2 million 90-lb boxes. Yields are expected to reach 1.58 gallons per box.

The benchmark July contract closed 0.10 cent lower at 76.80 cents per lb, having ranged from 77.20 to 76.00 cents. September finished 0.15 cent firmer at 79.45 cents, while the remaining months settled 0.05 higher to 0.25 lower.
Volume was estimated at 3,000 lots compared with Monday's official 2,314 lots.
